name: minimax-image
description: MiniMax 图像生成（文生图 / 图生图），产物落盘后把路径交回模型。

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: 在 MiniMax 开放平台创建，保存在本机凭据文件里，不会写进项目配置。

fields.label: 模型
fields.hint: 文生图/图生图用 image-01；还可以用 image-01-live。

fields.label: API 地址
fields.hint: 需要走代理或镜像时改这里。

fields.label: 输出目录
fields.hint: 相对工作区的路径，生成的图片会落在工作区内。

edit_image.description: Generate a new image from an existing reference image (image-to-image). Pass exactly one local file path such as 'assets/portrait.png'; it is read from the workspace and sent as an inline data URL. MiniMax takes only one reference image per request. Works best with a single front-facing portrait, which keeps the same subject/character in the new scene. Returns the saved file paths.

prompt.description: What the new image should look like (max 1500 characters).

reference_images.description: Exactly one reference image: a workspace-relative path to a JPG/PNG (under 10MB), an https URL, or a data URL. For best results, upload a single front-facing portrait photo. MiniMax accepts only a single reference image per request, so pass a list with one element.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. Defaults to the configured value (1:1).

n.description: Number of images to generate, 1-9. Defaults to 1.

seed.description: Random seed. Reusing the same seed and parameters reproduces the image.

prompt_optimizer.description: Let the service rewrite the prompt before generating.

subject_type.description: Subject type. Only 'character' is supported today.

generate_image.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using MiniMax image generation and save it into the workspace. Returns the saved file paths. Use it when the user asks to draw, illustrate, render, or create a picture.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image (max 1500 characters).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. Defaults to the configured value (1:1).

n.description: Number of images to generate, 1-9. Defaults to 1.

seed.description: Random seed. Reusing the same seed and parameters reproduces the image.

prompt_optimizer.description: Let the service rewrite the prompt before generating.
